from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

repo = Path.cwd()
cases = [
    ('direct eval', 'eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 1),
    ('multiline eval', 'result = eval(\\n    \"1 + 1\"\\n)\\n', 1),
    ('comment', '# eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 0),
    ('string', 'text = \\'eval(\"1 + 1\")\\'\\n', 0),
    ('method call', 'obj.eval(\"1 + 1\")\\n', 0),
    ('ordinary builtin', 'value = len(\"text\")\\n', 0),
]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='eval-check-') as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    for filename in ('check.py', 'checks.json'):
        shutil.copyfile(repo / filename, root / filename)
    shutil.copytree(repo / 'src', root / 'src')
    fixture = root / 'src' / 'nested' / 'fixture.py'
    fixture.parent.mkdir()
    for name, source, expected in cases:
        fixture.write_text(source)
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', 'check.py'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == expected, (name, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        if expected:
            assert str(fixture.relative_to(root)) in result.stdout, (name, result.stdout)
        else:
            assert not result.stdout.strip(), (name, result.stdout)
        print(f'PASS: {name}')
